decisions_requested.statement: Accept EN VAMAKALA KE as a governed L01 v1.1 nominal/interview question functionally equivalent to Do you have a nickname?, without claiming a recovered HAVE/possession construction.
Approve new authored form NE as the v1.1 negation/absence primitive, entering @hnk/linguas/authored at CANDIDATE authority only.
Accept [NICKNAME] as the affirmative answer and NE VAMAKALA as the negative/no-nickname response for this card.

evidence.question_frame: EN ... KE already has scoped precedent in validated L01 cards, but no possession meaning is retroactively assigned here.

explicit_non_effects: Does not create or recover a HAVE verb.
Does not assign YA or ES to possession.
Does not claim EN is historically a possessive marker.
Does not mark NE as recovered historical HNK.
Does not promote NE above CANDIDATE on first entry.
application_rule: Do not register NE canonically or transition OPI 2 to VALIDATED unless explicit human approval is recorded for this exact batch or equivalent scoped decisions.
